correctness.rationale: For the ordinary (not total) three-cut of the 2n-vertex Möbius ladder, n≥5, Alexander dual K has full 1-skeleton, exactly 6n connected induced triples and n square tetrahedra; 5-vertex dual faces are impossible by 5·4=3e contradiction. In d2, 2n unique distance-two chord rows isolate all cycle-path triangles and 3 signed edge rows per square have determinant ±1, giving a 5n×5n unimodular minor. Since n primitive disjoint tetrahedron boundaries lie in ker d2, rank d2=5n and ker d2=im d3 integrally. H1(K)=Z^{2n²−8n+1}; duality and connectivity upgrade Δ≃∨^{2n²−8n+1}S^{2n−4}. Equivariant Alexander duality adds ambient permutation sign to signed K-chain Lefschetz: all nonidentity rotations (−1)^a; reflection cases n even even/odd a: n−3,3−n; n odd:4−n,n−2. Invariant dimension floor((n−3)/2). Independently built ladder edges, all connected triples, square faces, and signed simplicial traces for n=5…10; all match; finite checks do not establish integral saturation, which relies on the uniform integer minor.
